description: This file defines a class 'BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' which subscribes to module status change events within the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling the 'buzz' module by updating data group permissions when its status changes.

classes.name: BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: Subscriber class that listens for module status change events, particularly for the 'buzz' module, to trigger permission updates accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events that this subscriber listens to, specifically the module status change event.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event; if the 'buzz' module was previously active, updates the permission for the dashboard_buzz_widget.
